summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SIEM Source Management, Webhook Ingestion, and Live Simulator features. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - 4 tabs visible, source creation dialog works with webhook URL and API key display, simulator start/stop works with LIVE badge, Event Log shows Source column.
seed_data_creation: Test sources created and cleaned up during testing. One existing source 'Test Splunk' remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SIEM source management, webhook ingestion, and simulator fully functional. Backend supports Splunk HEC, AWS CloudTrail, QRadar, and Generic JSON formats. Simulator generates events every 2-6 seconds. Event Log shows Source column with source names.

GET /api/siem/sources.details: Returns list of sources with event_count and last_event_at

POST /api/siem/sources.details: Creates source with source_key (src_xxx) and api_key (iv_siem_xxx)

POST /api/siem/ingest/{source_key} - Spl.details: Ingests Splunk HEC format with severity mapping

POST /api/siem/ingest/{source_key} - Gen.details: Ingests generic JSON with event_type, severity, details

Simulate Live button.details: Button toggles between 'Simulate Live' and 'Stop Simulation'

LIVE badge.details: Shows 'LIVE — X new events' when simulator active

Sources tab.details: Shows Add Source button and source list

Create source dialog.details: Has name input and 4 source type selectors (splunk, cloudtrail, qradar, generic)

Source created info.details: Shows webhook URL and API key with copy buttons after creation

Event Log Source column.details: Event Log table has Source column showing source names
